source_resolution.reason: EnteredCell assigns one of four native tombstones, then ShrineInitialize selects the named Resheph statue when a historical snapshot is available. Declared catalogue icon alone is not the stable native identity.
source_resolution.gospel: Description is supplied from native sultan history and JoppaShrine gospel; do not invent a fixed historical scene or inscription.

palette.primary: Declared ColorString y, black background k; no TileColor override declared
palette.detail: Declared g, with native RandomSubterraneanColors DetailColor r,c,w,Y for inside zones only
palette.worship: Native WorshipColorString Y / WorshipDetailColor C; preserve event-owned appearance
palette.rule: Use semantic neutral primary/detail and one coverage; do not freeze all runtime states to a single preview palette.

native_behavior.scope: Keep native history initialization, look/reveal, worship, interior random-color behavior and solid mounted-furniture ownership. No new animation, clock or history content.
